protocol.name: independent_ring_family_reconstruction_v1
protocol.question: Can independently defined RLCS-like lag correlation and CES-like correlation eigen-spectrum add after-wearing information beyond F0?
protocol.historical_identity: not claimed; original implementation is unavailable
protocol.source: LibEMG CIILData-main Electrode Shift archive already verified in DATASET_MANIFEST.json
protocol.trial_aggregation: mean window feature per native trial

feature_definitions.RLCS_reconstructed: existing 25 ms smoothed rectified envelope; circular-lag cross-channel correlation mean and standard deviation, lags 1..4, eight dimensions
feature_definitions.CES_reconstructed: normalized descending eigenvalues of full envelope correlation matrix, eight dimensions

protocol.classifier: per-subject source-only StandardScaler and balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=1000 seed=20260924
protocol.selection_rule: No changed definition, arm, subject, domain or hyperparameter after looking at validation or final outputs.
protocol.scope: Independent current-code reconstruction on public 8-channel Myo wearing data; not historical RLCS/CES equivalence, not user's device or realtime recognition.
